item.tib: gu ru'i thugs rgyud yid bzhin nor bu las mdos kyi spyi mchong nam mkha'i rgyan mchog
item.coloph: zhes gu ru'i thugs rgyud yid bzhin nor bu las/ mdos kyi spyi mchong nam mkha'i rgyan mchog ces bya ba 'di yang kho bo bde chen snying pos gsang ba'i lung dang gzhung don ci bzhin legs par bgyis pa 'dis kyang sngags kyi bstan la phan par gyur cig/
